summary: A DNR cab from Stranger Mountain, WA, moved to private land near Fernwood, Idaho and rented since 2018; sources disagree on the move year and tower type.

facts.design: DNR live-in cab on a tower; Idaho Fire Lookouts gives a 20-foot iron tower, while the Washington register gives a 40-foot wooden tower for the 1959 cab

access.note: Privately owned. Stays are booked through an Airbnb listing. Idaho Fire Lookouts warns visitors not to trespass to view the tower.

visit.trail_note: Booked guests only, on private land. A 4WD vehicle is needed; in winter, access is by snowmobile or a ride with the owner.

facts.agency: Privately owned (Idaho); the cab originally belonged to the Washington Department of Natural Resources

events.note: DNR live-in cab on a 40-foot wooden tower at Stranger Mountain near Chewelah, WA, per NHLR (which also gives the earlier name Stensgar Mountain); the Airbnb listing and Small Home Tours say the 1959 lookout that later went to Idaho was built on Stranger Peak
At Stranger Mountain, the 1959 cab was replaced by a newer DNR cab on a 42-foot wooden tower, per NHLR
Moved to private land in northern Idaho and used as a hunting lodge. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1982.

corrections.current: None relocated (Moved from Stranger Mountain, Washington to Crystal Ridge.)
corrections.proposed: Relocated 1983 from Stranger Mountain to private land in northern Idaho (Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1982)
corrections.why: The record says the cab moved but gives no year. The Airbnb listing and Small Home Tours give 1983. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1982.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1982. The Airbnb listing and Small Home Tours give 1983. The story uses 1983 and mentions the 1982 date.

Idaho Fire Lookouts describes a 20-foot iron tower. NHLR's Washington text gives a 40-foot wooden tower for the 1959 cab and a 42-foot wooden tower for the 1983 cab. The story reports both and does not choose.

The Idaho Fire Lookouts page is titled Crystal Ridge, but its rental link goes to an Airbnb listing titled Crystal Peak Lookout. Firelookout.org lists a standing Crystal Ridge tower and a separate Crystal Peak tower marked gone. The story uses Crystal Ridge for the standing tower.

NHLR's 2008 account says the cab came off a 40-foot tower, but its own description gives 42 feet for the 1983 tower. The register's wording is kept as a discrepancy, and this record does not depend on it.

sources.title: 1950s fire lookout transformed into off-grid shelter

notes_for_editor: Lineage is consistent: NHLR says the 1959 cab was replaced in 1983, and the Airbnb listing and Small Home Tours say a 1959 lookout left Stranger Peak in 1983 (Idaho Fire Lookouts says 1982). The Washington record (us-wa-stranger-mountain) says the 1983 cab went to Colville in 2008; the two records should be checked against each other so the Stranger Mountain facts match. The Washington record's 1994 staffing refers to the mountain, not this cab, so it is not used here. Unverified: a June 2026 BoiseDev headline (seen only in search results; the page returned 403) says the owner has listed this property for sale. It is not in the story; check before publishing any status change. Elevation of 4,729 ft from Idaho Fire Lookouts is not a facts key, so it is left out. Idaho Crystal Peak (gone) is about 1.5 km from the Crystal Ridge coordinates. No new photos with usable URLs were found.
